sentences.text: Acrorhizodus khoratensis is the sole species in an extinct genus of hybodont sharks, distinguished by a unique mix of traits not seen in other families.
This animal belongs to the class Chondrichthyes, which includes cartilaginous fish, and sits within the parent group Hybodontiformes.
Fossils were found in the Khok Kruat formation near Si Mueang Mai, Thailand.
It lived between 121.4 and 100.5 million years ago during the Aptian to Albian stages.
